simple.meaning: מַרְפֵּא (marpêʼ) appears 16 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with prophetic witness.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Chronicles, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Jeremiah, Malachi, beginning at 2 Chronicles 21:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַרְפֵּא (H4832) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַרְפֵּא through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מַרְפֵּא (marpêʼ) / H4832 is tracked through 2 Chronicles 21:18, 2 Chronicles 36:16, Proverbs 4:22, Proverbs 6:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

structuredEvidence.definition: properly, curative , i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine , or (abstractly) a cure ; figuratively (concretely) deliverance , or (abstractly) placidity

firstOccurrence.englishText: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

timeline.evidenceText: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.
For they are life to those who find them,
Therefore his calamity will come suddenly.
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword,
A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
The life of the body is a heart at peace,
A gentle tongue is a tree of life,
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck
If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
We looked for peace, but no good came;
‘Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

definitions.full: H4832. marpe מַרְמֵּה מַרְמֵּא, noun masculine Eccl 10:4 healing, cure, health (usually figurative); — absolute מַרְמֵּא Jer 14:19 +, מַרְמֵּה 8:15 ; construct מַרְמֵּא Prov 15:4 ; — 1 healing, cure , of national woes, Jer 8:15 ; 14:19 b (|| שָׁלוֺם ), 36:6 (+ אֲרֻכָה ); especially מ לָנוּ ׳אֵין 14:19 a there is no cure for us , מ לְאֵין ׳עַד 2Chr 36:16 . 2 figurative of person , health, profit , Prov 4:22 (|| חַיִּים ), 12:18 ; 13:17 ; 16:24 ; with spiritual implication Malachi 3:20; מ ׳אֵין 6:15 = 29:1 ; מ ׳לֵב 14:30 a mind of health (healthy, composed, mind), compare ׳מ alone = composure Eccl 10:4 ; ׳מ לְשׁוֺן Eccl 15:4 healing of the tongue , = a soothing tongue (Toy). 3 literally, of disease , מ ׳לְאֵין 2Chr 21:18 .
